audit.why: Rumble's Flamespitter cone (600 range, 10/9/8/7/6s) plus Electro-Harpoon (850 range, 2 charges, MR shred) genuinely out-zones a melee approach early; the existing text says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldown breakdown quote no real numbers, and treat Scrap Shield as the matchup-defining cooldown.
audit.why: Scrap Shield is a 6s cooldown at every rank — it is never a window. Flamespitter (10s rank 1) and The Equalizer (130s rank 1) are the punishable cooldowns; your Wind Wall is 25s rank 1 and Last Breath 70s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Attach 10s Flamespitter, 130s Equalizer, 25s Wind Wall and 70s Last Breath to the spike and cooldown text; drop the Scrap Shield framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one decisive kit interaction is never stated: Electro-Harpoon is Rumble's only projectile and Wind Wall deletes it.
audit.why: Rumble's E carries the projectile flag; Q is a cone and W/passive are self-buffs. The page correctly says Wind Wall cannot block the cone but never says what it CAN block. Harpoon also shreds MR before the flame damage, which is why the wall matters.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall (W, 25s at rank 1) eats both Electro-Harpoon charges; it does nothing to Flamespitter. Save it for his step-up harpoons, not the wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns builds the plan around Scrap Shield.
audit.corrected: Trade as Flamespitter's 3s burn ends, on its 10s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.why: packet suspectName on wants.you[1] ('Use Sweeping Blade') is a FALSE POSITIVE — Sweeping Blade is Yasuo's real E name. The line's advice was wrong for a different reason (dashing does not dodge a 850-range harpoon), so it was rewritten anyway.

edits.before: Use Sweeping Blade (E) on minions to dodge Electro-Harpoon (E) slows
edits.after: Wind Wall (W) his Electro-Harpoon (E) — it is his only projectile

edits.before: Scrap Shield sustain and Q poke keep him ahead at level 2.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is up every 6s, so his level-2 poke never stops.

edits.before: Rumble's Flamespitter (Q) plus Scrap Shield (W) lets him zone you off every wave — the Q melts you if you walk in to CS, and his heat-boosted abilities out-poke you while your Wind Wall (W) can't block his sustained flame cone.
edits.after: Rumble's Flamespitter (Q) plus Scrap Shield (W) lets him zone you off every wave — the cone melts you as you walk in to CS, and Wind Wall (W) cannot block it. Wall his Electro-Harpoon (E) instead, and step in as the 3s burn ends on its 10s cooldown.

edits.before: He keeps control through levels 4-6 — heat-boosted abilities out-poke you, Electro-Harpoon (E) slows pin you for more Q damage, and The Equalizer (R) lets him deny farm or chunk you from range without committing.
edits.after: He keeps control through levels 4-6 — heat-boosted abilities out-poke you and Electro-Harpoon (E) slows pin you for more Q damage, but Wind Wall eats both harpoons on a 21s cooldown, so spend it on his step-up rather than on the wave.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Scrap Shield is up every 6s — it is never your window; Flamespitter (10s at rank 1) is. - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, spend it on Electro-Harpoon. - Last Breath: 70s at rank 1, kill windows only.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Rumble with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Electro-Harpoon shreds your MR before the flame lands, so take Mercury's Treads early and Wind Wall his harpoons.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1 — leave sideways, never dash along it.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield: Bait it, then commit. When it is down — EQ-R him.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats Electro-Harpoon, not the Flamespitter cone — Q2 knockup into R.
